PR #64 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/64

Summary of what shipped for Phase 8 (Master orchestration, cron wiring, report software):

- **`ai-os-scripts/audit_pipeline_master_orchestrator.py`** — the single cron-eligible entrypoint that invokes all 10 existing domain `audit_pipeline_*.py` scripts (Phases 1-6), zero AI in the loop, then triggers the report generator as its final step.
- **`ai-os-scripts/generate_auditor_engine_master_report.py`** — read-only aggregation of `audit_findings`/`audit_runs`/`audit_events` across all domains and repos into a JSON snapshot + history table.
- **Zero new crontab entries filed** — matching the phase's own scope text exactly.
- Live-verified with 2 real runs against the production knowledge_engine DB (idempotent on the 2nd run); along the way I found (but correctly left unfixed, since it's already-shipped Phase 2 code) a pre-existing bug where `audit_pipeline_api_contract.py` bakes an absolute task-workspace path into its finding hash, causing spurious duplicate rows whenever a new task workspace re-runs it — documented honestly in the phase-8 evidence.
- Phase 8 is now closed out in the plan file, both success criteria (knowledge_engine query + phase-plan grep) verified directly, and phase 8 is the last phase in this plan — closing it correctly lets `auto_phase_continuation.py` move on to other work.
